text: You prepared for the power to go out but did you prepare for the toilet to stop working? Most people stock up on water food and flashlights but forget about the bathroom. That's where these Cleanwaste toilet kits come in. Each kit has a waste bag with powder that gels liquid and helps control odor. You also get toilet paper a hand wipe and a zip close disposal bag. You can even use it with a regular toilet that won't flush. It's one less thing to figure out during an emergency. Add these to your emergency supplies.
